For enterprise use, CUGA adds what this benchmark does not test: rules that the harness enforces and deployment inside your own boundary.
Community lists such as awesome-agent-harness and best-of-Agent-Harnesses track nearl

en.reason: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment.
